findings.evidence: Mathlib already has the ingredients at `Semiring`+`StarRing` level: `Matrix.diagonal_mem_unitary : diagonal d ∈ unitary (Matrix n n R) ↔ d ∈ unitary (n → R)` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/UnitaryGroup.lean:57) and `Pi.const_mem_unitary_iff` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Star/Unitary.lean:237); with `Subsingleton.elim`, `S = diagonal (fun _ ↦ S default default)`, so the general statement is a three-line proof. `unitaryGroup` itself only assumes `[CommRing α] [StarRing α]` (same file, line 100).
findings.fix: State `theorem mem_unitaryGroup_iff_apply_default_mem_unitary [Unique n] (S : Matrix n n α) : S ∈ unitaryGroup n α ↔ S default default ∈ unitary α` for `[CommRing α] [StarRing α]` and derive the `‖·‖ = 1` version over `RCLike` from it (via `RCLike.conj_mul`); keep the norm form, since `Unitarity.lean` uses it.
findings.issue: `mem_unitaryGroup_iff_norm_apply_default_eq_one` is restricted to `[RCLike 𝕜]`, but the fact it encodes is purely algebraic: for `[Unique n]`, `S ∈ unitaryGroup n α ↔ S default default ∈ unitary α` over any `[CommRing α] [StarRing α]`. The file sits in the `Matrix` namespace (so it is written for upstream), where the `RCLike`-only form is the wrong level.

findings.evidence: Lines 215-216 and 223-224 are the same seven-step chain `norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_I, Complex.norm_two, norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ.le`, differing only in the final `eq_div_iff` vs `le_div_iff₀`; line 247 repeats `norm_I, norm_mul, Complex.norm_two, norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ.le` for the centre.
findings.fix: Add `norm_elasticSMatrix (hρ : 0 < ρ) (t : ℂ) : ‖elasticSMatrix ρ t‖ = 2 * ρ * ‖t - I / (2 * ρ)‖` (immediate from `elasticSMatrix_eq_mul_sub`) and derive both iffs from it with `eq_div_iff` / `le_div_iff₀`; it also shortens the `hc` step at line 246.
findings.issue: `norm_elasticSMatrix_eq_one_iff_norm_sub_eq` (213) and `norm_elasticSMatrix_le_one_iff_norm_sub_le` (221) are the `=` and `≤` shadows of a single unstated equality `‖elasticSMatrix ρ t‖ = 2 * ρ * ‖t - I / (2 * ρ)‖`, and each re-proves it with the identical rewrite chain; `norm_le_one_div_of_norm_elasticSMatrix_le_one` (246) recomputes a third piece of the same arithmetic.

summary: Hypotheses in `Unitarity.lean` are minimal and the real/complex phase-shift pair is properly derived, but the new `Matrix` lemma is stated at an analytic level when its content is ring-level, and the Argand circle/disc pair repeats one unstated norm identity.
